answer: What survives to the dawn is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the harbor of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work.
